atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Injects Tailwind's base, components, utilities, and variants styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines the styles of one or more existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Assigns a block of CSS to one of Tailwind's layers (base, components, utilities) so it's ordered correctly.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, etc.) as CSS variables that Tailwind turns into utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Adds a file or directory to Tailwind's automatic source detection, in addition to what it finds on its own.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom utility class that participates in variant support (hover:, lg:, etc.) like Tailwind's built-in utilities.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind variant to styles inside a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom variant that can be used like a built-in one (e.g. hover:, dark:).

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript-based Tailwind plugin directly from CSS.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript-based Tailwind config file directly from CSS.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Imports theme variables and custom styles from another file without duplicating its output CSS.
